limits: This is a review candidate, not a certified 4px / 95% clear-edge match.
Every covered16/8cell has a diagnostic comparison; generated coverage is separate from manual review and acceptance.
The original24 evidence controls overlap fitting anchors. Only the separately frozen verification set is reported as independent.
Single photographic station: depth, backing and mounting thickness are inferred. A shallow battery panel and backing opening preserve the original service access.
The original service door and generator context differ from the photographed room and remain visible when not occluded by this assembly.
Vented-cabinet function and hidden electrical topology are unverified. Unreadable labels are not invented.
Local static reflections are approximate during nominal cutaway.
Hardware desktop/mobile FPS is not certified by SwiftShader.
downloadMethod: Unique selected-profile response payloads; includes the reused bulkhead GLB if uncached. Engine/default-room/context downloads are separate. Functional test resource timings include reload and failure cases.

resources.method: Resident buffer and texture payload estimate; excludes canvas/MSAA, global light lookup tables, programs and driver caches.
resources.peakLimit: Sampled payload estimate, not measured driver allocation; short-lived peaks may fall between samples.

defaultRegression.interpretation: Four changed pixels in the rear240000px image (three1-level color differences and one boundary pixel). With the unpartitioned old room GLB substituted into the current viewer, both views are pixel-identical to baseline. This isolates the difference to triangle grouping/rasterization, not a changed shader or engine geometry. Full triangle-attribute multiset preservation is checked independently.

recordedPartitionRasterTolerance.scope: Cross-version default regression only; motion/rest deterministic test still requires zero differences.

authoringBinding.method: All decoded production triangles matched once by physical world positions, winding and material; UV0 disambiguates near-coincident faces. Per-corner physical UV0 and lightmap UV1 copied from the public GLB, preserving geometry.

uvDestinationRepair.cause: Blender copied UV0 into a newly created UV1. Unused micro coordinates could overlap the macro image bake.

proof.cause: Blender copied UV0 into a newly created UV1. Unused micro coordinates could overlap the macro image bake.
